intro: When a vital shipment of guard payroll went missing from the Crossroads guard tower, the defenders caught an impossible culprit: a wild raptor. Perplexed and enraged by the heist, Gazrog orders a retaliatory cull to prevent the cunning beasts from striking again.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower. It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.
The strange thing is... We caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft. And... It was a raptor! Unbelievable!
I don't know what raptors would want with silver. But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!
Hunt raptors in the Barrens. Collect for me their heads!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those heads, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got rid of the raptors!
Thank you, friend. You are an adventurer of worth.
